title: toolpick tool catalog
description: The tools your agent can call, in one provider-neutral format.

name.description: A label for this catalog, shown in reports.

instructions.description: The system prompt your agent normally runs with. Optional; a neutral default is used otherwise.

categories.description: Optional category name -> one-line description. Needed for the category strategy to route well.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema for the arguments; its top-level type must be object.

mutates.description: Optional: true if the tool changes state. Informational only.
